name: sessionlog_replace_section
description: REPLACE one section of a turn (PUT). section in: actions, tags, context, dialog, commits, designDecisions, requirementsDiscovered, filesModified, blockers. sectionJson is a UnifiedRequestEntryDto whose matching property holds the new contents; an empty/omitted property clears the section. Other sections untouched.

section.description: Section name (e.g. tags, actions, commits, designDecisions)

sectionJson.description: JSON UnifiedRequestEntryDto carrying the section's new contents
